answer: Each identity locks a 70-credit bond in a vault and must trade with 40 independent counterparties on the bridge market per tide. Only counterparties with distinct vault keys and trade history count, so a bridge-ring collapses to one and burns. Hiring one real counterparty costs 25 credits: one fake costs 40 x 25 = 1,000; 1,000 fakes cost 1,000,000 per tide. An honest agent pays 70 once and keeps its full share with trades it already makes.
